column1: # The core irregular verbs of Eastern Armenian, hand-supplied.
# UniMorph hye's 898 lemmas are a thin slice of the language and happen
# to contain none of the everyday verbs (գալ, տալ, ուտել, անել, լինել,
# …), so these never enter the two-oracle agreement and cannot be mined
# from it. Each row below is the paradigm the uniparser grammar gives
# corrected: it derives թողրել/թողրած for թողնել (standard թողել/
# թողած) and տվր for the imperative of տալ (standard տուր).
# scripts/hye/armtdp_check.py re-checks every form here against the
# attested tokens of the UD Armenian-ArmTDP treebank — an independent,
# hand-annotated corpus — so the corrections are not taken on trust.
